title: My experience
content: I’ve been having these types of dreams nearly every night for about 3 years. I’m so glad I found this sub and I wanted to share my experience. My dream world has a few settings. I guess we can start with my dream apartment, which is similar to my real apartment except in my dreams I’m always in some conflict with the neighbors or being asked to move apartments or I come home only to realize that the maintenance man had broken in. When i settle down and look out my window, it’s *always* a huge halloween parade with hundreds of people all dressed up. A very popular costume trend for kids is costumes with jetpacks in them, so people walk and float by. The town around my dream apartment is way more of a city than my real town. Sometimes i have dreams of getting lost in the streets. Sometimes the city floods and I have to try and get home. Along the coast is a beach area with a big pier, and it’s always super crowded. If you go further down there’s a few rustic looking vacation houses. I always stay in the house in the middle and the bathroom is super modern and doesn’t match the rest of the apartment at all. There’s a train/subway system and sometimes i take it to an amusement park. The park has an old school metal slide that floats in the sky and i can never convince anyone to go on it with me. If I drive inland I end up at my college… it’s similar to my real college but also really different. In my dreams I can walk around and remember old dorms I had lived in during previous dreams and get super nostalgic. I want to go back and visit my old dorms, except i don’t have a key anymore. Sometimes I also visit the student store and try on hats and stuff. Which brings me finally…. to the mall. From the outside it’s mostly a brick building, but at one end it kinda morphs to metal and there’s a big movie theater. Inside the stores are almost all connected so people have to walk through each store to get to the next store. In the parts that do have hallways there’s big screens sticking up from the ground with ads on them. To the left is a big shoe store. I also frequent a department store and a dollar tree type store. There’s a food court/ cafeteria-esque place, but I’m not sure if it’s at the mall or the college. There’s different counters you go to for different types of food and people sit in groups with their friends. Next to the cafeteria is a convenience store The movie theater at the end of the mall is one of my favorite places. Usually it’s packed and people love the films they show. When the movie is over I usually go up this twisty hallway and end up at the grocery store except it’s mostly all frozen food items. There’s a lot more that I’m mossing. Typing this out makes me realize how many of these dreams are kinda based on an anxious feeling. I wish i could become lucid during these dreams so that i could realize it was fake. Although in the actual dream, i am very good at recalling information or plot points from previous dreams. Do any of these places sound familiar to you?
